roomExtent.note: baked surfaces only; outside this there is nothing to see

notes: Units are metres, Y up (glTF). Every mesh has one UV set (TEXCOORD_0) into a single shared 4096 atlas. Draw all meshes unlit (MeshBasicMaterial or a shader that mixes the two atlases); the lighting, wood colour and wall colour are already in the textures. Load the atlases as sRGB with flipY = false (glTF UV convention) and no tone mapping. Full texel density covers the default 16:10 view; the far left, low and near parts of the room are baked at about 40% density for wider or taller viewports. There is no floor. The bulb is its own mesh: in the 'on' atlas it is bright, so a soft CSS/sprite glow at bulbCentre sits well on top. All materials are matte, so the bake is correct from any camera angle.
